overview.description: The WisdomTree U.S. Corporate Bond Fund (QIG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks an index composed of investment grade, US corporate bonds. Constituents are selected and weighted by fundamental company and bond risk characteristics. QIG was launched on Apr 27, 2016 and is issued by WisdomTree.
